Global Engagement Cell, Ministry of Culture, New Delhi

Retired Government Officer, retired from a post not below the rank of Under Secretary, with communication and interpersonal skills, exposure in coordination with different organisations, knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel and Power Point, and expertise in drafting/noting, budget/accounts and office procedure.

content_sections.heading: MoC Consultant Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The venue is given in the official notification (see the link below).

content_sections.heading: MoC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 159-1/2020-ICR gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MoC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Retired from the post not below the rank of Under Secretary; Communications and interpersonal skills; Exposure in coordination with different organisations; Knowledge of computer applications such as MS Word, MS Excel and Power Point; Expertise in drafting/noting, budget/accounts, office procedure Experience: Retired Government Officer not below the rank of Under Secretary Age limit: Below 62 years Other conditions: Knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel and Power Point Expertise in drafting/noting, budget/accounts and office procedure Applicant certifies that no disciplinary proceedings are pending against him or her

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MoC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Officers who retired below the rank of Under Secretary

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fixed monthly amount equal to the pay drawn at retirement minus the basic pension (commuted portion included); unchanged for the contract term, with no increment, percentage increase or DA; no HRA; fixed Transport Allowance not exceeding the rate at retirement. Initially for one year, which may be extended or curtailed as per requirement and satisfactory performance Purely on contract basis; confers no right for regular appointment Guidelines strictly advise not to continue engagement beyond the age of 65 years Paid leave of 1.5 days per completed month; accumulation beyond a calendar year not allowed Attendance in AEBAS mandatory; failure may result in deduction of remuneration Non-disclosure undertaking and confidentiality agreement to be signed

content_sections.heading: How Will MoC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview before the Selection Committee In the Ministry (Secretariat proper) the committee: Joint Secretary (Admn.) Chairperson; Director/DS (concerned Div.) Member; Deputy Secretary (Estt.) Member Interview time 4:30 PM after reporting at 4:00 PM

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form (Annexure-II) with recent photograph Duly filled experience proforma (APPENDIX) Copy of PPO Original documents One set of self-attested copies

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MoC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form given as Annexure-II of the notice. Attach the experience proforma (APPENDIX) and a copy of the PPO. Appear before the Selection Committee on 16-11-2026 (reporting 4:00 PM) with the filled form, original documents and one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for MoC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MoC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Consultant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MoC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated monthly remuneration regulated as per Department of Expenditure O.M. dated 09.12.2020 and Ministry of Culture guidelines: last pay drawn minus basic pension, fixed for the contract term.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired Government Officer, retired from a post not below the rank of Under Secretary, with communication and interpersonal skills, exposure in coordination with different organisations, knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel and Power Point, and expertise in drafting/noting, budget/accounts and office procedure.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel and Power Point. Expertise in drafting/noting, budget/accounts and office procedure. Applicant certifies that no disciplinary proceedings are pending against him or her.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers who retired below the rank of Under Secretary.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview before the Selection Committee. In the Ministry (Secretariat proper) the committee: Joint Secretary (Admn.) Chairperson; Director/DS (concerned Div.) Member; Deputy Secretary (Estt.) Member. Interview time 4:30 PM after reporting at 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for one year, which may be extended or curtailed as per requirement and satisfactory performance. Purely on contract basis; confers no right for regular appointment. Guidelines strictly advise not to continue engagement beyond the age of 65 years.
